property: The TCP-era Telnet core specification is formally revised while preserving the Network Virtual Terminal and option-negotiated terminal/process communication role.
negative_claims: This edge does not collapse the earlier NCP/ad hoc Telnet RFC genealogy into one direct step.
It does not imply every Telnet option specification is unchanged between the two generations.
open_questions: Build the complete RFC 318/435/intermediate-option genealogy leading to RFC 764 and RFC 854.
